source.verification: Versioned snapshot and normalizer, not current Postgres content

rationale.primary: Owner-approved neutral primary actions: pure black fill and white text in light mode, pure white fill and black text in dark mode. Primary action labels use the real bold weight; brand accent, chart tones and semantic destructive colors keep their own roles.
rationale.ring: Derived shades sized for existing upstream 50% ring opacity: dark red in light, pale orange in dark. No ring geometry or opacity changed.
rationale.selection: Neutral text selection pairs. Interactive controls have a separate neutral selected treatment.
rationale.preserved: All base neutral tokens including accent, secondary, surfaces, text, muted, border/input, destructive and chart series remain unchanged.

colorFormat: OKLCH: literal theme and brand colors use oklch(); semantic aliases retain var(). Conversion preserves approved sRGB appearance.

density.root: Browser default (100%, no fixed px override)
density.preserved: Root user preferences, 1px borders and radius tokens; no zoom/transform
density.calendarNarrow: Day grid can shrink to 24px minimum at narrow widths; spatial grid exception, not a blanket 44px target claim.

supportingCustomization.rationale: Tonal chart palette derived from the canonical Brand Accent through OKLab mixes with the themed foreground. No extra hue families. Theme-specific steps, labels, dash patterns, cell shapes, interactive isolation and data tables carry identification; adjacent tones are not certified by surface contrast. Semantic status colors and explicitly neutral modes remain independent.

componentExtensions.status: Shared RAMS foundations with additional component detail primitives.

replace.purpose: Replace content with a single owner of presence.

resize.purpose: Preserve continuity during a size change.

morph.purpose: Preserve the identity of an object.

displayReveal.purpose: Introduce a composition once, with a bounded sequence.

data.purpose: Interpolate data without changing its final value.

activity.purpose: Indicate real activity, with a static alternative.

emphasis.purpose: Highlight new content once, without repetition or delaying the action.

reduced.policy: Show the final state without waiting for animation; preserve focus and content.

details.densityAuthority: Existing density.scales compact/default/wide; base aliases reference active root --spacing and --text-*. No zoom, transform or root-font override.

semanticStatus.success: RAMS semantic color adopted as explicit RAMS extension candidate.
semanticStatus.warning: Light candidate darkened to48% L for text; contrast not yet measured.
semanticStatus.info: Supporting chart-1 as candidate informational role.
semanticStatus.note: Add distinct foreground/subtle-background/border roles if rendering filled status controls. Never assume the text role is also a safe fill.

details.shadows: Exact RAMS resting/raised/floating/thumb recipes, centralized and theme-specific. Geometry and subtle inset shadows local to components remain in source until individually audited.
details.radii: Shared shapeCustomization roles: control18/panel26/surface34px at root16. Select panel20/item14 and menu item20 derive from outer radii. Circle/pill/group/directional/decorative geometry is intentional.
details.gradients: Keep RAMS compositions but derive stops from RAMS primary/supporting chart-1/card. Hero mesh/syntax/user-chosen colors need documented content exceptions.
details.focus: Do not emit RAMS global !important selectors. Scope copied focus policy to RAMS component roots and every portalcontent, and use --rams-detail-focus-outline=RAMS ring.
details.themeAuthority: RAMS .dark only; source data-theme selectors adapted. ThemeSwitch controlled by RAMS.
details.portalAuthority: This base emits on :root and inherits through body portals; each previewiframe gets root RAMS tokens then bridge. Wrapper-only scope is insufficient.
details.densityLimits: Hardcoded px/rem sizes and SVG/Motion coordinates in source still need role-based conversion;3density values refer to foundation-bound dimensions only.

motionUnits.spring: Physical parameters preserved by named, file-specific exceptions; visual presets share roles.
